subject.title: docs: respect configured Crabbox provider for agent tests

question: Should eligible trusted maintainer validation, including PR-maintainer workflows, honor `CRABBOX_PROVIDER` before the Blacksmith Testbox fallback?
rationale: This changes an established validation-backend default and ambient environment behavior; code review can verify consistency and safety, but only maintainers can authorize that repository-wide policy.

options.title: Align all workflows
options.body: Approve explicit provider, then `CRABBOX_PROVIDER`, then Blacksmith fallback and update the required PR-maintainer skill in this PR.

options.title: Keep PR validation Testbox-first
options.body: Retain the new precedence for ordinary Crabbox work but explicitly require Blacksmith Testbox for maintainer PR validation.

options.title: Pause the policy change
options.body: Keep current Testbox-first guidance until a broader validation-routing decision is documented.

recommendation.title: Align all workflows
recommendation.body: Approve explicit provider, then `CRABBOX_PROVIDER`, then Blacksmith fallback and update the required PR-maintainer skill in this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The root trusted-validation default and most adjacent policy history point to this owner for the repository-wide precedence decision.
